The initial project phase is estimated at 1,200 total hours over a six-month period, with an estimated budget of $130,000.00 USD. Client acknowledges that this figure is a non-binding estimate. Provider shall notify Client immediately if project scope changes threaten to exceed $150,000.00 USD.
findings.explanation: Although described as a non-binding estimate, setting specific hour and budget targets creates client expectations and potential disputes over project velocity, opening the door to scope creep and pressure to absorb extra work.
findings.suggested_change: Add a clear change-order mechanism stating that any additional hours required due to evolving requirements will be formally documented and billed at the agreed hourly rates without penalty.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a wonderful day. Before we finalize everything, I would like to request a minor update to the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause on project hours and budget, listing specific targets can create confusion about project scope and workload, so I propose including a clear change-order mechanism to ensure any additional hours needed for evolving requirements are documented and billed at the standard hourly rates. Thank you for your time, and I look forward to moving ahead.
